tools.name: contents_create_inventory
tools.description: Create a new contents inventory for a property. Requires a name. Optional fields: inventoryType (home, rental, business), address, salesTaxRate (decimal, e.g. 0.08), defaultCarrier (insurance carrier name), defaultPolicyNumber.

tools.name: contents_get_inventory
tools.description: Get a single contents inventory by ID. Returns the inventory record including name, type, address, status, and insurance details.

tools.name: contents_list_inventories
tools.description: List all contents inventories for the authenticated user. Returns an array of inventories with their IDs, names, types, and statuses.

tools.name: contents_update_inventory
tools.description: Update an existing contents inventory. Provide inventoryId and any fields to change: name, inventoryType, address, salesTaxRate, defaultCarrier, defaultPolicyNumber, or status (active, archived).

tools.name: contents_archive_inventory
tools.description: Archive (soft-delete) a contents inventory by ID. This sets the status to 'archived' and hides the inventory from active lists. Rooms and items are preserved.

tools.name: contents_create_room
tools.description: Create a room within a contents inventory. Requires inventoryId and name. Optional: roomType (living_room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, garage, basement, attic, office, dining_room, other), description.

tools.name: contents_list_rooms
tools.description: List all rooms in a contents inventory. Requires inventoryId. Returns rooms with their IDs, names, types, and item counts.

tools.name: contents_update_room
tools.description: Update a room in a contents inventory. Provide roomId and any fields to update: name, roomType, description.

tools.name: contents_delete_room
tools.description: Delete a room from a contents inventory. WARNING: This also removes all items assigned to that room (items move to unassigned, not deleted). Provide the roomId.

tools.name: contents_create_item
tools.description: Create a contents item in an inventory. Requires inventoryId and name. Optional: roomId, description, category (electronics, furniture, clothing, appliances, jewelry, tools, sporting_goods, other), brand, model, serialNumber, condition (excellent, good, fair, poor), quantity, purchaseDate (ISO string), purchasePrice, rcv (replacement cost value), acv (actual cash value).

tools.name: contents_list_items
tools.description: List contents items in an inventory. Requires inventoryId. Optional filters: roomId (filter by room), category, condition. Returns items with valuations.

tools.name: contents_get_item
tools.description: Get a single contents item by ID. Returns full item details including description, category, make/model, condition, purchase info, and valuations (rcv, acv).

tools.name: contents_update_item
tools.description: Update an existing contents item. Provide itemId and any fields to change: name, roomId (or null to unassign), description, category, brand, model, serialNumber, condition, quantity, purchaseDate (ISO string), purchasePrice, rcv, acv.

tools.name: contents_delete_item
tools.description: Permanently delete a contents item by ID. This cannot be undone. The item will also be removed from any active claims.

tools.name: contents_get_inventory_stats
tools.description: Get statistics for a contents inventory: total item count, room count, total RCV (replacement cost value), total ACV (actual cash value), items by category, and items by condition.

tools.name: contents_analyze_room_photo
tools.description: Start an async AI vision session to detect items from room photos. Requires roomId and a non-empty array of photoUrls (publicly accessible image URLs). Returns a vision session ID — use contents_get_vision_session to poll for results. Detected items require review via contents_confirm_detected_item, contents_edit_detected_item, or contents_skip_detected_item.

tools.name: contents_analyze_multiple_photos
tools.description: Start an async AI vision session for multiple room photos (up to 10). This is the same as contents_analyze_room_photo but explicitly accepts multiple URLs for batch photo analysis. Requires roomId and photoUrls array. Returns a vision session ID for polling.

tools.name: contents_get_vision_session
tools.description: Poll the status of a vision analysis session. Returns status (pending, processing, completed, failed), detected items (with names, categories, estimated values), and any errors. Poll every few seconds until status is 'completed' or 'failed'.

tools.name: contents_confirm_detected_item
tools.description: Confirm a vision-detected item, adding it to the inventory as a real contents item. Requires the detectionId from a completed vision session. Returns the created contents item.

tools.name: contents_edit_detected_item
tools.description: Edit a vision-detected item before confirming it. Allows correcting AI-detected values: name, category, make, model, condition, quantity, purchasePrice, rcv, acv. Provide detectionId and a changes object with fields to update.

tools.name: contents_skip_detected_item
tools.description: Skip (dismiss) a vision-detected item. Use this when the AI detected something that should not be added to the inventory (e.g., false positive, duplicate, or irrelevant object). Requires the detectionId.

tools.name: contents_calculate_item_valuation
tools.description: Calculate ACV (actual cash value) and RCV (replacement cost value) for a single contents item using depreciation tables based on category, condition, and age. Returns the computed valuations and depreciation breakdown. Requires itemId.

tools.name: contents_bulk_valuate
tools.description: Bulk calculate ACV and RCV for all items in an inventory that don't yet have valuations. This is more efficient than calling contents_calculate_item_valuation for each item individually. Returns a summary with counts of valuated items and total values.

tools.name: contents_get_depreciation_rates
tools.description: Get the depreciation rate tables used for ACV calculations. Returns rates by category and condition, useful for explaining to clients how their items are being valued or estimating what valuations will look like.

tools.name: contents_get_valuation_summary
tools.description: Get a valuation summary for an entire inventory: total RCV, total ACV, total depreciation, breakdown by category, and count of unvaluated items. Requires inventoryId.

tools.name: contents_create_claim
tools.description: Create an insurance claim for a contents inventory. Requires inventoryId. Optional: lossDate (ISO date string), lossType (fire, flood, theft, storm, water_damage, vandalism, other), deductible (amount), carrier (insurance company name), policyNumber. The claim starts in 'draft' status.

tools.name: contents_get_claim
tools.description: Get a contents claim by ID. Returns the claim with status, loss info, insurance details, and all claim items with their claimed/approved amounts.

tools.name: contents_list_claims
tools.description: List all claims for a contents inventory. Requires inventoryId. Returns claims with their IDs, status, loss type, dates, and totals.

tools.name: contents_update_claim
tools.description: Update an existing contents claim. Provide claimId and any fields to change: lossDate, lossType, deductible, carrier, policyNumber, claimNumber (assigned by insurer), adjusterName, adjusterEmail, adjusterPhone, or status (draft → submitted → negotiating → settled → closed). Status transitions are enforced.

tools.name: contents_snapshot_claim_items
tools.description: Snapshot all valuated inventory items onto a claim. This copies items with their current RCV/ACV valuations into the claim as claim items. Only works on claims in 'draft' status. Use this after contents_bulk_valuate to populate the claim with items ready for submission.

tools.name: contents_update_claim_item
tools.description: Update a specific item within a claim. Requires claimId and itemId. Can update: claimedAmount (amount being claimed for this item), approvedAmount (amount approved by insurer), adjusterNotes. Used to record adjuster decisions on individual items.

tools.name: contents_export_claim_pdf
tools.description: Trigger async PDF generation for a contents claim. Returns a job ID and status. The PDF will include all claim items with descriptions, purchase info, RCV/ACV values, and claimed amounts. Use contents_list_pdf_exports to check status and get the download URL.

tools.name: contents_list_pdf_exports
tools.description: List all PDF exports for a contents inventory, with signed download URLs. Requires inventoryId. Returns exports with status (pending, completed, failed), creation date, and downloadUrl when ready.

tools.name: contents_set_item_ownership
tools.description: Set owners for a contents item. Provide itemId and an array of owners. Each owner requires ownerName, ownershipType (e.g. sole, joint, community, trust), and sharePercent. Optional per-owner: acquiredDate (ISO date string), provenanceNote, proofUrl. Share percentages must sum to exactly 100%. Replaces all existing ownership records atomically.

tools.name: contents_get_item_owners
tools.description: Get all ownership records for a specific contents item. Returns each owner's name, ownership type, share percentage, acquired date, provenance note, and proof URL.

tools.name: contents_get_division_summary
tools.description: Calculate a property division summary across an entire inventory. For each unique owner, returns their item count and total share of RCV and ACV values. Items with no owners are counted as 100% belonging to the inventory owner. Pro tier required.

tools.name: contents_export_division_report
tools.description: Generate a PDF division report for an inventory. Creates an async export job and returns the exportId. The PDF includes per-owner value breakdowns for all items. Use contents_list_pdf_exports with the inventoryId to check status and retrieve the download URL when ready. Pro tier required.

tools.name: contents_register_partner
tools.description: Apply as a B2B2C partner for the Contents & Claims service. Requires power tier. Provide companyName (your business name) and slug (unique URL-safe identifier). Optional: logo (URL), brandColor (hex color), tagline. Returns the partner record with status 'pending' pending approval.

tools.name: contents_get_partner_dashboard
tools.description: Get the partner dashboard for the current user. Returns: partner record, clientCount (number of referred clients), inventoryCount (inventories managed under this partner), totalRevenue (sum of paid invoices), and recentActivity (summary strings). Requires power tier.

tools.name: contents_list_partner_clients
tools.description: List all clients referred by this partner. Partner must be approved. Returns an array of client records with userId, status, and createdAt. Requires power tier.

tools.name: contents_invite_partner_client
tools.description: Invite a client by email address to join under this partner. Partner must be approved. If the email is not yet registered, a stub user record is created. Returns the ContentsPartnerClient record. An invitation email will be sent (stubbed). Requires power tier.

tools.name: contents_list_partner_invoices
tools.description: List all billing invoices for this partner. Returns invoices with amount, status (pending, paid, overdue), and billing period (periodStart, periodEnd). Requires power tier.

tools.name: contents_update_partner_branding
tools.description: Update the partner's branding settings: logo (URL or null to clear), brandColor (hex color or null to clear), tagline (short description or null to clear). Pass only the fields you want to change. Requires power tier.

tools.name: contents_add_collaborator
tools.description: Add a collaborator to an inventory by email address. Requires manager or owner role on the inventory. The target user must already have a Kynver account. Provide inventoryId, email (the collaborator's email), and role (viewer | editor | manager | owner). Returns the new ContentsCollaborator record. Requires pro tier.

tools.name: contents_list_collaborators
tools.description: List all collaborators on an inventory. Requires at least viewer role. Returns an array of collaborator records each including user name and email, their role (viewer | editor | manager | owner), and createdAt. Requires pro tier.

tools.name: contents_remove_collaborator
tools.description: Remove a collaborator from an inventory by their collaborator record ID. Requires manager or owner role. Cannot remove the inventory owner. Returns { ok: true } on success. Requires pro tier.

tools.name: contents_update_collaborator_role
tools.description: Change a collaborator's role on an inventory. Only the inventory owner can change roles. Cannot change your own role. Provide collaboratorId and the new role (viewer | editor | manager | owner). Returns the updated ContentsCollaborator record. Requires pro tier.

tools.name: contents_list_receipts
tools.description: List all receipts for an inventory. Returns receipt records including OCR status, store name, purchase date, and total amount. Requires inventoryId.

tools.name: contents_upload_receipt
tools.description: Upload a receipt record for an inventory. Provide inventoryId, fileName, and the publicly accessible url of the uploaded receipt image or PDF. Returns the created receipt with ocrStatus=pending. Run contents_run_receipt_ocr next to extract data.

tools.name: contents_run_receipt_ocr
tools.description: Run AI-powered OCR on an uploaded receipt to extract store name, purchase date, line items (with descriptions, quantities, and prices), and total amount. Automatically redacts any credit card numbers found in the result. Returns the updated receipt with ocrStatus=completed and structured ocrResult data.

tools.name: contents_smart_match_receipt
tools.description: Match OCR-extracted receipt line items against existing inventory items using name similarity scoring. OCR must be completed first (run contents_run_receipt_ocr). Returns an array of matches: each line item is paired with the best matching inventory item (if any) and a confidence score from 0.0 to 1.0.

tools.name: contents_browse_memory_jogger
tools.description: Browse the Memory Jogger catalog of 5,200+ common household items organized by category. Helps users remember what they own. Without categoryId, returns all categories (free tier: up to 3 categories; pro: unlimited). With categoryId, returns paginated items for that category. Use page and limit for pagination.

tools.name: contents_search_memory_jogger
tools.description: Search the Memory Jogger catalog by item name. Returns matching items with their category information. Available on all tiers. Use this to help users find specific items they want to add to their inventory.

tools.name: contents_add_jogger_items_to_inventory
tools.description: Add one or more Memory Jogger catalog items to an inventory. Provide the inventoryId, an array of jogger itemIds (from browse or search), and an optional roomId to assign items to a room. Creates ContentsItems using the jogger item names, categories, and average prices as the starting purchase price. Respects tier item limits.

tools.name: contents_find_replacements
tools.description: Find replacement products for a contents item. Pro-tier feature. Uses the item's name, brand, and category to suggest replacement products from major retailers. Returns a list of products with retailer, price, URL, and rating. Useful after a loss event to help users replace their belongings.

tools.name: contents_mark_item_purchased
tools.description: Mark a contents item as purchased (replacement acquired). Pro-tier feature. Updates the item's purchasePrice and purchaseDate, and optionally records the retailer. Use this after a user has replaced an item following a loss event. purchaseDate must be an ISO date string (e.g. '2026-03-15').
